description: Melbourne Wastewater - Daily Volume Received by Melbourne Water is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. This data provides daily accumulated inflow volumes for wastewater treatment at the two Melbourne Water site (Western and Eastern). This data is collected using network flow monitoring devices. This data has been processed and stored as official inflow volumes received by Melbourne Water over a 24 hour period (12am to 12am). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are daily, eastern treatment plant, flowrate, melbourne, sewage. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
